content.short: UniDex is a decentralized meta-aggregator for swaps and a perpetual exchange platform.
content.description: UniDex aggregates multiple price aggregators to help traders consistently secure the best available rates across markets and across supported chains. By combining liquidity from diverse sources, it aims to deliver competitive pricing and tighter execution. In addition, UniDex offers a perpetual leverage trading platform that opens access to a broad spectrum of markets, including forex, crypto, ETFs, and other asset classes, all within a single interface across multiple blockchains.
